author: separate Claude subagent instance (same model family as the policy author; NOT human-independent)
author_inputs: classification task, declared evidence-validity policy, registry vocabulary with matching semantics, artifact rules (5% language floor; parsed root manifests; Docker presence), output schema, coverage targets; NO R4/D/R3 rules, code, tests, design sets or results
author_tool_calls: Write x3 (one per part file); no read/search/command; author reported no post-write edits
leakage_disclosure: the author's hand-back message (read by the policy author before the design freeze) named about ten case-level details; no policy change was made after it
